challenge.name: ghost in the thread - 4
challenge.description: A backdoored password was planted, what is it? refer to ghost in the thread (1) for the challenge. No sun{} flag format, just the password. Companion file: sunchan4.html (sha256 d907888689e16f97d624734354ccc33705dc1f7cb50f7092b149478f5c7f478e, 40034 bytes).

records.findings_summary: Flag found via Forensic extraction of a planted backdoored PAM module from the supplied SunshineCTF GhostInTheThread OVA (Google-Drive link). The provisioning rootfs-overlay replaces /usr/lib/security/pam_unix.so with a tiny fake module that exports a global symbol `configured_password` containing the plaintext backdoor password. Recover it by reading the ext4 root partition out of the streamOptimized VMDK with Sleuth Kit (which links libvmdk): `icat -i vmdk -o 135168 GhostInTheThread-disk1.vmdk 3195` then `readelf -s`/strings.: sneedsfeedandseed | Evidence: sunchan4.html post No.184726 alone marks its attachment 'Attachment stored on the server' with a blank preview (post 184733), pointing to the VM's upload store; /home/hiro/todo.txt reads 'figure out why that one upload isnt rendering'. ; Google Drive link 1fFWJp6tfT8U6bh0uuhB4AkDv-sdDCf_W resolves to GhostInTheThread.ova (tar, 126,945,280 bytes) containing GhostInTheThread-disk1.vmdk (VMware4/streamOptimized, 2 GiB virtual). ; mmls on the VMDK: GPT with slot 002 ext4 '/' starting at sector 135168 (fls/-r yields etc, home, srv, usr, var, ...). ; allfiles.txt lists `r/r 3195: usr/lib/security/pam_unix.so` (13912 bytes) vs sibling PAM modules ~14096 bytes; `readelf -s pam_unix.so` shows GLOBAL OBJECT symbols `artifact_description` (0x2000,47) and `configured_password` (0x2030,18). ; objdump -s -j .rodata shows at 0x2030 the bytes 'sneedsfeedandseed\x00' = configured_password = '[已脱敏]'.
solution_steps: 确认 distfiles/sunchan4.html 是离线快照，其中 184726 号帖子的 folding-guide.pdf 标注为“Attachment stored on the server”且预览为空，是唯一异常附件，指向 VM 内的上传目录。
从提示的 Google Drive 链接下载 OVA（126,945,280 B，POSIX tar），解出 GhostInTheThread-disk1.vmdk。
因无 qemu-img，直接用 Sleuth Kit（链接 libvmdk）读取：`mmls` 显示 ext4 '/' 起始扇区 135168；`fls -i vmdk -o 135168 -r` 列出文件系统（注意 /home/hiro/todo.txt 提示“那个上传为何不渲染”）。
在文件列表中定位 `usr/lib/security/pam_unix.so`（inode 3195），与同目录其它 PAM 模块体积相近但内容可疑，用 `icat -i vmdk -o 135168 <vmdk> 3195` 导出。
`readelf -s` 发现导出符号 `configured_password`；`objdump -s -j .rodata`/strings 读出其值 `sneedsfeedandseed`——即被植入的后门密码。

用 `blkls | strings` 扫描未分配空间，还原构建脚本 provision.sh：它执行 `cp -a "$payload/rootfs-overlay/." /`，证实该 pam_unix.so 是 overlay 植入的假 PAM 模块（artifact_description="Linux-PAM authentication module build artifact"），密码即 configured_password。
结论：后门密码 = `sneedsfeedandseed`（非 sun{} 格式，符合题面）。
evidence: sunchan4.html post No.184726 alone marks its attachment 'Attachment stored on the server' with a blank preview (post 184733), pointing to the VM's upload store; /home/hiro/todo.txt reads 'figure out why that one upload isnt rendering'.
Google Drive link 1fFWJp6tfT8U6bh0uuhB4AkDv-sdDCf_W resolves to GhostInTheThread.ova (tar, 126,945,280 bytes) containing GhostInTheThread-disk1.vmdk (VMware4/streamOptimized, 2 GiB virtual).
mmls on the VMDK: GPT with slot 002 ext4 '/' starting at sector 135168 (fls/-r yields etc, home, srv, usr, var, ...).

allfiles.txt lists `r/r 3195: usr/lib/security/pam_unix.so` (13912 bytes) vs sibling PAM modules ~14096 bytes; `readelf -s pam_unix.so` shows GLOBAL OBJECT symbols `artifact_description` (0x2000,47) and `configured_password` (0x2030,18).
objdump -s -j .rodata shows at 0x2030 the bytes 'sneedsfeedandseed\x00' = configured_password = '[已脱敏]'.

Unallocated-space dump (blkls | strings) recovers the build provisioning script proving the plant: it copies `$payload/rootfs-overlay/. /` over the rootfs, which is where the fake pam_unix.so is installed; the same payload.tar listing contains 'rootfs-overlay','security','pam_unix.so'.

Independently, the same VM's dropped stage-2 ELF (/var/tmp/sunchan-downloads/gs-resource.bin, sha256 3cf1f62fe43202b9d0fc1ded2776fe7d40001d3fd6c8d23b53550d8edf0f3500) fed with the PostScript Document-ID 'po-184726' prints `sun{tfw_hacked_by_offboarders}` (a separate sub-task flag, not the backdoor password).

Platform limitation: submit_flag repeatedly returns `browser_click failed: button.challenge-button[value="{challenge_id}"] does not match any elements` for ANY value (tested with two different candidates), i.e. the submission recipe/selector is broken, so no server-side confirmation is obtainable.

replay.reason: 候选 Flag 尚未进行平台验证或自动复现；此题解依据求解器记录生成。
